about_the_game:
Get your paws tappin’ and your tails swingin’ with the Jumping Jazz Cats Original Soundtrack! Featuring 23 original songs, this album sets the rhythm for every high-flying leap, daring dash, and chaotic cat caper in the game. From smooth swing to energetic bebop, each track is crafted to match the pulse of the action, dynamically shifting during gameplay to keep you on your toes (or paws).

Composed to capture the charm and mischief of feline parkour, these tunes bring the lively world of Jumping Jazz Cats to life with brass blasts, groovy basslines, and toe-tapping melodies. Whether you're reliving the game's most intense moments or just looking for the perfect jazz playlist, this soundtrack is a must-have for lovers of playful, high-energy music.

So crank up the volume, let the music move you, and get ready to jump, slide, and swing to the sound of the Jumping Jazz Cats Original Soundtrack!
